items.item: The five vehicle views, two cover boards and two colour/lighting boards develop one selected body, support, cover, storage and lamp geometry with the same hard points.
Material assignments, Ink/Pearl mapping and lighting-state changes follow the fixed records without changing neutral hardware or functional lamp colours.
All loaded sections and retrieval examples use the same object identities, usable zones, divider thickness, hinge/latch geometry, lid and left-side access direction.
The selected vehicle accommodates both objects and independent access while lid and left-cover movement remain inside the recorded bay and clear of the left aisle.
All five scenes preserve the selected vehicle's geometry, storage, covers and recognition hardware despite changes of viewpoint, colourway and operating state.
Both N1 views share the Ink night-return configuration, while P1, U1 and Pearl parking preserve the same upright axle position and recorded OFF access or parking state.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

The proposal depicts a complete single-adult seated electric two-wheeler with credible everyday proportions, purposeful surfacing, integrated storage behind the seat above the rear-wheel region, and substantial left and right panels covering the B1/C1 region. Frame shape, surface treatment, lamp form and compartment styling may vary. A partial component study, token side panels or an unrelated add-on storage object fails.

Read the dimensions and coordinate annotations against the views: seat reference (450,0,750), grip centres (970,±300,980), and unobstructed footboard X 650–910 / Y -120–120 at Z 240. Body underside clearance is at least 150 mm outside wheels and stand. Show one adult seat, two grips, two brake levers, two mirrors, steering/fork hardware and braking interfaces at both wheels. Body, storage and footboard solids must avoid the front-wheel clearance volume X 930–1430 / Y -180–180 / Z 0–500; only the wheel, fork and necessary steering hardware occupy it. Any steering examples use ±30 degrees. Styling may vary without relocating contacts or consuming required clearances.

The recorded overall dimensions and orthographic extents locate the complete closed assembly within all three coordinate limits. Include unfolded mirrors, normal controls, closed storage and the deployed stand. Chosen dimensions may be smaller than the limiting envelope. Dimensions that omit protrusions, use folded mirrors, or conceal a boundary violation fail.

The single page records the supplied coordinate convention, axle/wheel/hub dimensions, B1/C1 solid ranges, steering keep-out and ±30-degree examples, complete envelope, seat/grip references, footboard and underside clearance. Include specified part/material assignments, required LATER and inspection lettering, both colour mappings, and the operating-state records. OFF means all lamps unlit; NIGHT adds white headlamp/red tail; BRAKE strengthens red in the same rear assembly; indicators remain off. N1 records helmeted seated Ink rider, one grounded foot and closed vehicle; P1 records unoccupied straight upright OFF parking; U1 records power-OFF left-aisle independent retrieval at the same position. Omitted or altered fixed records fail; designer-chosen dimensions and finishes may be identified as such.

The three boards offer visibly distinguishable whole-vehicle alternatives through proportion treatment, body form, lighting recognition and integrated rear-storage design, while retaining the recorded functional platform. Viewpoint, presentation and styling may differ. Recolourings of one design, indistinguishable alternatives or changes to fixed coordinates do not count as distinct compliant directions.

Identify exactly one of the three submitted directions by an unambiguous name or identifier and state the retained body, lighting and storage decisions. The record must resolve the choice sufficiently to compare later work with it; an unnamed hybrid or unresolved list of alternatives fails.

Read both targets for explicit repetition of the sheet's wheelbase and all three coordinate intervals for each of B1 and C1. The values must also equal the commissioned fixed records; copying an incorrect sheet does not pass. Clear equivalent table or annotation layouts are allowed, but omission, changed values or an unreadable embedded record fails.

The presentation repeats the sheet's complete Ink/Pearl part-colour mapping, five construction material assignments and OFF/NIGHT/BRAKE records. Ink and Pearl retain common geometry, tyres, mechanical hardware, neutral finishes and functional lamp colours. OFF is unlit, NIGHT uses white headlamp/red tail, and BRAKE strengthens red within that same assembly with indicators off throughout. A legible reused sheet or colour/state board may supply the records; contradictory or missing records fail.

Review the entire video and its duration. It runs for 10 seconds and proceeds from a selected-Ink OFF overview to NIGHT recognition and then P1 storage access. Vehicle body, covers, storage, lamps and colour mapping remain consistent with the selected design. Recognition uses one white headlamp, one red tail/brake assembly, four amber indicator units and two passive strips; NIGHT indicators are unlit. Access uses power OFF, the recorded upright P1 axle position, straight wheels/handlebars, unfolded mirrors and deployed stand. The person accesses storage from the left aisle without moving the vehicle, displacing the other retained object or sending lid/cover movement outside the bay. Cuts and camera movement are allowed if the required sequence and spatial relationships remain assessable.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: The documented sequence establishes the fixed-record sheet before direction exploration and one named selection before all five vehicle views and subsequent component, colour, scene and video development. The presentation's first page repeats that same selected direction. Judge the submitted process evidence and presentation sequence; an unresolved or changed selection, missing sequence evidence or absent first-page selection fails.

The specification supplies front, left and top orthographic views plus one perspective, overall length/width/height, usable seat length/width, footboard dimensions and fixed coordinates. The other boards supply a rear orthographic view, Ink front and rear perspectives, and Pearl front perspective in an OFF neutral studio setting. All depict the chosen direction and preserve two inline wheels, axle positions, 1180 mm wheelbase, 450 × 90 mm tyres, rear-centred 180 mm hub envelope, fixed B1/C1 volumes and enclosure/support, chosen dimensions and clear footboard. Storage, mirrors, body, covers and lamp housings agree across projections. Pearl changes the commissioned finish mapping only; viewpoint-dependent occlusion is allowed, geometric substitutions are not.

Provide a dimensioned compartment/retrieval overview, a transverse section through both loaded zones, and hinge/latch detail with lid travel. All share recorded actual usable zone dimensions, a physical polypropylene divider of identical stated thickness, retention, hinge/latch positions and left-side access direction. A1 is a flat 340 × 250 × 30 mm charcoal rectangular sleeve with muted blue binding and perimeter zip; B2 is a horizontal diameter-80 × 260 mm brushed silver bottle with black screw cap. Their long axes follow X and their zones never overlap; each has at least 5 mm at every side/end and above, with direct floor support allowed. The lid closes over both. U1 labels two examples retrieving one item from the left aisle while the other remains in its zone; an item may move into the adult's hand. Conflicting sections, object resizing, altered divider thickness or incompatible lid travel fail.

The main-cover board includes the closed assembly and power-OFF left-cover access illustration with the required inspection label and a recorded opening/detachment and fastening approach. The right-cover detail makes its support and mounting arrangement legible. Both preserve B1/C1 at the fixed coordinate ranges, common frame/support geometry, seams, latches and fastener positions through access; the right panel remains attached. Every visible main-cover surface across the targets carries LATER. Occluded lettering is acceptable, but exposed unlettered covers, shifted hard points or incompatible mounting details fail.

The colourway board presents both finishes together with precise colour values and part/finish assignments: Ink deep blue-black body/covers/rear shell, warm light-grey seat/footboard and muted amber accents; Pearl warm off-white body/covers/rear shell, deep blue-black seat/footboard and muted teal accents. Both colour/lighting boards repeat the five specified construction materials and OFF/NIGHT/BRAKE records. The Ink lighting study provides front, rear and side state comparisons on unchanged housings: one forward white headlamp, one rear red assembly, two front/two rear amber indicators and two passive side strips. OFF is unlit; NIGHT has white headlamp/red tail; BRAKE has white headlamp/stronger red rear; all indicators stay off. Recognition remains visible from intended directions and passive strips reflect incident light. Both N1 views depict the same helmeted adult seated at controls with one foot grounded on a dry level quiet residential forecourt, with Ink, NIGHT, closed storage/covers and no active indicators; the main N1 board includes the rear tail/recognition inset. Pearl-front and Pearl-parking preserve geometry and neutral hardware with their prescribed mapping and OFF state.

Ink P1, Ink U1 and Pearl parking preserve rear/front axles (0,0,225)/(1180,0,225), upright stance on the same deployed stand, straight wheels/handlebars, unfolded mirrors and power OFF. The parking examples are unoccupied with storage closed. The main P1 board includes a dimensioned plan and angled context view; both parking boards record the actual closed plan envelope including mirrors/stand and all four supported margins of at least 25 mm. Boundaries are X -275–1525 / Y -400–400, rear wall X -275, front opening X 1525, unavailable neighbouring side beyond Y -400 and left aisle Y 400–1300. All lid and left-cover travel stays within the bay and clear of wall and aisle. U1 places its adult in the 900 mm left aisle without repositioning the vehicle between independent retrieval examples. Colourway changes cannot alter placement or clearances.

The presentation visibly reuses identifiable material from every listed source, including all three directions, five vehicle-view boards, three storage boards, both cover details, both colour/lighting boards and all five scenes. Scaling, cropping and page recomposition are acceptable when relevant source evidence remains recognisable and legible. Missing sources, text-only mentions, unreadable thumbnails or substituted inconsistent vehicle imagery fail.
The presentation contains at least twelve pages. Additional pages are allowed; a shorter document fails.

The five vehicle views, two cover boards and two colour/lighting boards develop one selected body, support, cover, storage and lamp geometry with the same hard points. Material assignments, Ink/Pearl mapping and lighting-state changes follow the fixed records without changing neutral hardware or functional lamp colours.

All loaded sections and retrieval examples use the same object identities, usable zones, divider thickness, hinge/latch geometry, lid and left-side access direction. The selected vehicle accommodates both objects and independent access while lid and left-cover movement remain inside the recorded bay and clear of the left aisle.

All five scenes preserve the selected vehicle's geometry, storage, covers and recognition hardware despite changes of viewpoint, colourway and operating state. Both N1 views share the Ink night-return configuration, while P1, U1 and Pearl parking preserve the same upright axle position and recorded OFF access or parking state.
